input: looks like the actions usage hit a limit. I think it's necessary to start monetizing a certain degree and also work on actions usage optimization.

doc_friction.issue: Invariant 6's text calls Actions a 'metered allowance'; on this public repo minutes are free and the binding limit is 20 concurrent jobs. Left as is; invariant 9 states the concurrency limit.

deviations.why: The owner asked to start monetizing. 'Payments: never the owner's' forbids agents wiring the owner's payment account, and the 2026-10-30 billing plan leaves amending it to the owner, so this run shipped the Actions half and left billing as owner steps.
deviations.did: Reported the owner steps in chat; no payment code

notes: Local verification, because CI runners were queued: validate_workflows reports 125 files valid; pytest 451 passed, 1 skipped (platform/ci workflow-related suites); gitops/tests/test_ci_runner.py 24 passed; node devstats/pages tests 34 passed. No job-minute before/after: gh has no token in the container.
